ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface area (~92%) with localized high-intensity (white/light grey) pixel clusters (~8%) primarily at distal tips and surface scarring.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white clusters located at the extreme lateral tips (distal edges); approximately 18-22 discrete high-contrast annular rings (circular white outlines) distributed across the medial and lateral regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped depression with a measured interior pixel angle of approximately 70-80 degrees relative to the horizontal lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 3 to 10 pixels; peaks are notably sharp and jagged along the entire length of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave-to-convex transition; the trailing edge sweeps outward with an overall convex curve that terminates in heavily textured, irregular distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and semi-circular high-contrast white rings detected; higher concentration in the mid-section of the left lobe and lower-medial section of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of intersecting white linear pixel disruptions located in the lower-left quadrant near the base of the fluke, appearing as rake marks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense barnacle encrustations (high-contrast, textured white clusters) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes; extensive healed circular scarring consistent with parasitic detachment.
